scenario: ID Verification Submitted → Drive Upload + Admin Alert
trigger: POST from /api/onboarding/id-submission (handled by Agent A/existing code)
description: Fires when a client uploads their ID documents for verification. Make.com moves the uploaded files into the client's Drive ID Verification subfolder, updates GHL contact status to 'id_submitted', and sends an alert to the admin Discord channel for manual review.

payload.name: string — client's full name
payload.idFrontUrl: string — temporary URL to front-of-ID image
payload.idBackUrl: string | null — temporary URL to back-of-ID image (if provided)
payload.selfieUrl: string | null — temporary URL to selfie image (if provided)
payload.driveFolderId: string | null — Google Drive ID verification folder ID

makeSteps: Step 1: Receive webhook — parse file URLs and client info
Step 2: Download ID files from temporary URLs
Step 3: Upload files to client's Drive ID Verification folder
Step 4: Update GHL contact field id_verification_status = 'submitted'
Step 5: Post admin alert to Discord with client name + Drive folder link for manual review
